verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents standard OAuth 2.0/OIDC flows that issue user-delegated tokens, including the device authorization grant an agent could use for user consent. It also documents identity brokering and account linking with external providers. However, nothing in the pack shows that it stores third-party provider tokens or exchanges them for agent use. Missing for 10: documented token exchange, a vault or retrieval mechanism for brokered third-party API tokens, short-lived scoped delegation to external APIs, agent-specific guidance, and hands-on corroboration.
